source_evidence: Exact player 'All this time… and now we found it. Lets get to work figuring out its mysteries' expresses V's reaction and initiates scholarly investigation of recovered evidence, not new travel, hiring, spending, removal of tablets, unsafe structural entry, weapon retrieval, contact or overnight rest. D342~18:05–18:25 Mara and Cirren compare the actual copies of the door-jamb dedication, two docket tablets, cistern rim, D334 manor register, Caul's relative sketch, and the known Silverward record evidence. They assemble a concise field account with the existing maps/copies: surviving outer-seat identity and specifically allocated childhood apartment established by independent material and register matches; Silverward was a subsidiary service station of the old household, not proof of current ownership; audience and service rooms corroborate Caul's historical description of an administered mixed household. No additional independent name, parent fate, personal memory, supernatural sword or heart function, or precise whole-seat extent recovered from copies. Previously revealed D331 refuge/confinement evidence and D334 Caul testimony remain distinct; cannot infer V was personally confined there or a particular culprit. Cirren notes the stone guardians' original entry duty remains observable, not evidence of identity-recognition or control; no accessible control instructions found, and uninspected collapsed portions need genuine structural assessment before entry. Mara proposes bringing Caul to the now-located seat since D334 Caul welcomed an invitation and has firsthand knowledge; she could explain former layout and identify whether further archives were lost or dispersed, without guarantee. Mara recalls the previously revealed Pale Chancellor (scholar/jurist, custodian of selected older legal/occult records) as plausible next documentary lead, via Caul, and Amber Exarch as sacred-rights/treaties lead, neither informed or located; no contact made, hidden knowledge disclosed, or new quest accepted. Mara prepares field account copies for party's future choice, not surrendered to Coris/other actors, no payment earned/collected. As daylight fades Fenar proposes recovering weapons and choosing a safe camp rather than entering unstable rooms after dark. Party remains unarmed in forecourt, no automatic departure, new rest, contract, owner title or spending. Existing evidence of local discovery retained, no new invented hidden dungeon. No uncertainty roll required to compare already legible material; all resource, supply and custody state unchanged.
